summary: Implement fail-closed import/export recovery: malformed, truncated, version-newer, or password/DRM-protected inputs MUST produce a deterministic diagnostic receipt (what failed, at which decode stage, safe fallback) and MUST leave existing authority unchanged (no silent partial/corrupt write). Every lossy or transforming operation — rasterization, baking, preservation-blob, text-rasterized-on-export, unsupported-feature drop — MUST emit an operator- and model-visible receipt at the time it occurs. Receipts are the interop-fidelity audit surface, EventLedger-bound per [STU-ARC-003].
expected_tests: negative: malformed/truncated/version-newer/password-protected input -> diagnostic receipt + authority unchanged (no partial write)
test: each lossy op (rasterize/bake/blob/text-rasterize/drop) emits a time-of-op receipt
test: receipts EventLedger-bound
risk_if_missed: Silent partial/corrupt authority writes; unauditable lossy interop.
proof_targets: fail-closed recovery + lossy-op receipt test
acceptance: import/export fails closed with receipt; every lossy op receipted; receipts ledger-bound
